name: project-corrupt-skip
comment: Real data reject — '项目文件似乎已损坏（跳过部分：N）(26::0)': builder output has a structural/size bug so AE skips a layer/stream. Press OK so the project opens (with the part dropped) and the JSX catches the missing layer/path → writes .done(FAIL). Previously surfaced as exit 2 (unknown-modal) when OCR was occluded, masking a genuine reject as a flake — see incident-reports/ae2020-shape-ldta-164-corrupt.md + path-keyframe-write-re.md.

name: ae-safe-mode-recovery
comment: AE 'Safe Mode' / Recovery dialog after wrapper force-kill on prior run — ESC declines safe-mode, continues normal launch

name: script-alert
comment: ExtendScript alert() popup — Enter clicks OK. RE fixture JSX should write .done instead of alert(), but this is the defensive fallback for legacy scripts (see test_data/re_gradient.jsx)

name: startup-splash
comment: AE startup splash / About screen (class #32770, empty title, copyright text). On this machine AE 2020/2025 cold-start can linger 30-45s — longer than the unknown-modal grace — so without this it gets force-killed mid-init, which then cascades into a safe-mode dialog next launch (see incidents/ae-automation-occlusion-crashstate.md). action=Ignore: known-benign, do NOT send keys and do NOT escalate to exit-2 — wait it out (bounded by TimeoutSec) until AE finishes loading and the JSX writes .done. OCR-only match (never windowClass) so real #32770 dialogs (convert/corrupt/data-missing/safe-mode) still hit their specific CJK rules; localized error dialogs never contain the English copyright tokens.
